decisions.summary: Profile, Preferences and Auth security are self-scoped to the verified authenticated subject; no organization role grants access to another user's data.
Only active Owner/Admin membership in the selected organization may read or mutate Billing; client visibility and platform-admin status alone do not grant access.
Platform/Billing owners must decide whether Billing-specific shared permission keys are added; do not substitute broad organization.manage.
Reuse/coverage of shared user-scoped and Billing audit contracts, including read/link access, requires Platform Audit, Privacy and Finance owners.

actions: Mapped the approved Account actors and Owner/Admin-only organization billing rule to server-enforced scopes.
Inspected existing Platform permission catalog, membership/role helpers, organization audit and permission-checked Settings operations.
Defined RLS and elevated-server requirements for future self-scoped profile/preferences and organization-scoped Billing data.
Recorded sensitive-field rules, native/offline/cache behavior, provider/role gaps, security test cases and open owner decisions.

validation.evidence: Module run validation passed after the Account domain/access checkpoint updates.
All module run checkpoints parsed and validated.

requirements.evidence: access-design.md defines subject-bound self-service permissions and provider-owned security boundaries.
access-design.md requires active Owner/Admin membership and organization checks for all Billing reads and mutations.
access-design.md lists authorization test cases for deep links, IDOR, RLS, stale roles/caches, native/offline, exports, Files and Document Intelligence.
Billing permission-key naming, audit coverage, avatar policy, Auth capability and suspended-member behavior remain open with named owners.

notes: No Account/Billing production path was identified; its absent policy is recorded as baseline rather than an active exploitable path.
The agreed Owner/Admin boundary applies to Billing reads as well as mutations; no platform-admin bypass is inferred.
No production code, database policy, contract, fixture or migration was changed.
